summary: This PR fixes a bug in weighted mean calculation with boolean weights, but introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect.

issues.description: The change is a simple fix, but it could be improved by adding a comment explaining the reason for the dtype conversion.
The automated tests already pass, but it would be good to add additional tests to ensure the fix doesn't break other edge cases.
The code style is consistent with the repo, but the comment could be improved for clarity.
